prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one cohesive art direction review board for Orangegame, a portrait 2016 computer-brand workshop management mini game. Create a landscape reference illustration divided by quiet cream gutters into three clear panels. Left panel: a portrait-framed 2.5D isometric small workshop, warm wood workbenches, cream walls, neatly stacked plain component boxes, a single assembled desktop tower, test monitor and practical hand tools; orthographic isometric camera, clear uncluttered silhouettes. Middle panel: a much larger close-up open desktop computer tower, a technically recognizable side view with a rear I/O motherboard area, processor tower cooler, RAM sticks beside it, a horizontal dual-fan graphics card in its expansion slot, bottom power supply, two case fans, discreet storage mount and clean cable routes. Keep component shapes plausible and distinct; use purposeful non-neon cables, readable interior spacing, and tiny blank sticker areas. Right panel: one procurement-card visual, a cream card containing a clearly drawn standalone dual-fan graphics board at a three-quarter angle and an understated empty sticker/brand area, with blank space for later engine-rendered copy. Style: clean hand-drawn cartoon with confident dark slate outlines, simple flat color planes, restrained soft shading and gently rounded corners. Material: matte painted metal, plastic and warm wood; hardware details clear enough to recognize motherboard, graphics card, RAM and connectors at phone scale. Palette: cream, warm honey wood, soft orange accents, cool graphite hardware, restrained teal. Lighting: soft upper-left light with consistent subtle lower-right contact shadows. Maintain the same visual vocabulary across all three panels, friendly hardware humor conveyed through shapes and inviting workshop mood. No text, labels, numerals, watermarks, real manufacturer logos, dramatic neon RGB, photorealism, glossy 3D toy rendering, oily brush texture or noisy tiny decorative detail. This is a visual concept reference, not a functional UI screenshot or an engineering diagram. High-quality clean readable game illustration.
